messages:
Ana: Quick check — before I flip the TTFT sampling change in prod, can we run a golden benchmark to compare p95 & tok/s on the long-context workloads? I opened a tiny PR that toggles the sampling window. Need a 1h profiling window tonight.

Sam: What exactly is the change? sampling ratio or the aggregation window?

Ana: It's the aggregation window: reducing prefix sampling from 30s -> 5s and adding a short TTL for KV cache hits so we don't bias short-session cases. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks/pull/212

Devon: Heads-up: our dashboards currently roll up with 30s buckets — comparing 5s raw values will look noisy. We should align the dashboard or resample the bench output. Also p95 needs ~1k samples to be stable for the models we care about.

Maria: I can reserve a profiling window 22:00-23:30 UTC on the dedicated pool (pin a small set of nodes). Do you want that slot?

Ana: Yes please, Maria. If we pin ~8 GPUs we can keep background noise low. Sam, can you run the bench-runner with the long_context workload during that window?

Sam: Yep. Plan: start at 22:05 UTC with --workload long_contexts --seed 42 --duration 3600. I'll push the exact command here.

Sam: ```
# trigger bench-runner on bench infra
curl -X POST https://infra-api.redwood/bench/run \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $BENCH_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"workload":"long_contexts","seed":42,"duration":3600,"label":"ttft-sample-5s"}'
```

bench-bot: scheduled bench job 8745 queued by Sam (eta start 2024-11-12T22:05:00Z) :clock10:

Devon: For the dashboard side I'll add a temporary panel that resamples the bench output to 30s buckets and a separate panel that shows the raw 5s windows + sample count. Also adding tokens/sec (tok/s) per-model column so we can compare throughput.

Ana: Awesome. Two small asks: 1) add a column with sample-count so we can filter p95 by sample threshold, 2) annotate the run in Grafana with the PR number so we can correlate.

Devon: Will do both. I'll also add a note in the panel description about KV-cache TTL interaction so future readers know why numbers jump around for var-length contexts.

Maria: Pool pinned, 8 GPUs reserved. If bench-runner needs extra disk on nodes let me know now.

Sam: Starting run at 22:05. I'll paste the run summary and a small CSV of per-model p50/p95/tok_s in this thread when complete.

bench-bot: job 8745 started on pool-dedicated-3 :rocket:

Ana: Thank you all — if anyone sees big anomalies during the run please ping @Maria immediately. I'll follow up with a short write-up and proposed dashboard changes after the run. :eyes:
